plan: Deep-copy the recipe so adapt() never mutates inputs; print_original() returns authored_text verbatim.
Compute a Fraction scale factor target_yield / recipe.yield and apply it to every quantity, including component ingredients and substitution-introduced ingredients.
Index the catalog by the 'for' name with entries ordered by (priority, catalog position) for deterministic selection.

Resolve each excluded ingredient with a rewrite loop: apply the best choice's result (quantity_factor, unit, preparation, yield_factor, name), tracking the chain of visited names to report 'substitution cycle involving NAME' and reporting 'no substitution for NAME' when no option exists.

Accumulate wording {old,new} pairs, equipment additions/removals, and additional ingredients from applied results; feed additional ingredients back through the same exclusion resolution via a worklist so reintroduced exclusions are caught.
Build final equipment as (original + additions - removals), sorted, and emit 'equipment NAME unavailable' for every item missing from available_equipment.

Collect all failure reasons before deciding: if any, return possible=False with recipe null, sorted deduplicated reasons, considered choices, and sorted warnings; otherwise return the adapted recipe with applied wording changes, ordered choice IDs, and sorted warnings.
mechanisms: Immutable adaptation via copy.deepcopy of the recipe
Priority-then-catalog-order sorted substitution index for deterministic choice
Exclusion rewrite loop with chain-based cycle detection
Worklist propagation of additional ingredients under the same exclusion/catalog rules
Global accumulation of wording changes applied to all instruction strings
Set-based equipment reconciliation with sorted output and per-item availability reasons
Exhaustive reason collection (set, sorted) instead of first-failure abort
